item.title: US House passes $1.2 trillion spending package to end government shutdown
item.description: The spending package only funds the Department of Homeland Security for two weeks, through February 13.

item.title: Collision between Greek coastguard vessel, migrant boat kills at least 14
item.description: Greece's coastguard says 26 other people have been rescued from Aegean Sea as search-and-rescue operations continue.

item.title: These exiled Venezuelans dream of returning home. What’s stopping them?
item.description: In January, the US removed Nicolas Maduro from power. But Venezuelans in exile say it is still too dangerous to return.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,441
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,441 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: Palestinian women recount ‘journey of horror’ at Gaza’s Rafah crossing
item.description: Palestinian women tell of harrowing experience at hands of the Israeli military at reopened Rafah crossing in Gaza.

item.title: Bus crashes in Brazil’s Alagoas state, killing at least 16 people
item.description: Survivors, including a seriously injured child, taken to hospital as state governor declares three days of mourning.

item.title: ‘A great honor’: Key takeaways from Trump’s meeting with Colombia’s Petro
item.description: Despite months of clashing over US military attacks and drug trafficking, the two leaders shared a 'terrific' meeting.

item.title: Thousands march in Venezuela to demand US free President Maduro, wife
item.description: Pro-Maduro protesters hold banners calling on US to release 'kidnapped' President and First Lady Cilia Flores.

item.title: China warns Panama as Hong Kong firm contests ruling on canal ports
item.description: China calls court ruling against Hong Kong firm CK Hutchison on Panama Canal ports 'absurd' and 'shameful'.

item.title: LIVE: Israeli attacks kill 10 Palestinians; restrictions at Rafah crossing
